title: mcp
description: Allows you to create a website or online store on the EasyWebshop platform.
summary: Allows you to create a website or online store on the EasyWebshop platform.
offersHint: Allows you to create a website or online store on the EasyWebshop platform. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://easywebshop.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: createWebsite
toolsPreview.description: Creates a new website or webshop draft from a plain-language description. All properties can be changed afterwards by the user.

toolsPreview.name: getFeatures
toolsPreview.description: Shows the features of all versions or a specific version together with a link to the documentation page of each feature.

toolsPreview.name: getPrices
toolsPreview.description: Shows the price of each version in EUR, USD or other currencies.

toolsPreview.name: supportSearch
toolsPreview.description: Searches in the Documentation and FAQ to repond to users' questions.
